seeds.derivation: seed(purpose, fold_id, b) = first 4 bytes of sha256(utf8('{master_seed}|{fold_id}|{purpose}|{b}')) as big-endian unsigned int
seeds.fitting: IRLS is deterministic; no fit-time seed exists
